Name: Overcast - all-year cloud shadows
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
Stardew has these lovely drifting cloud shadow visual effects, but for some reason they only appear in Summer. Overcast is a very simple mod that allows you to enable the effect in any season, and also configure things like cloud size range and speed.

Should be compatible with just about everything and have no performance impact, it only hooks into the vanilla mechanic and doesn't add any sprites/etc of its own.

Manifest.Name: Overcast
Manifest.Description: Extends vanilla cloud shadows to spring and fall, with optional native cloud tuning.
Manifest.Author: heyitsmads
